our_interpretation: Read put money into as OpenAI's own capital contribution or direct funding of Stargate development, consistent with the surrounding discussion of capital contributions.

Uncertainty about who pays is a qualification, not an antecedent that must occur.
A definite obligation to contribute at least USD 1 billion can settle will have to before all cash is paid. An aspiration or proposed contribution cannot.

criteria.contradiction_condition: The relevant project is definitively completed or terminated with verified total OpenAI contributions below USD 1 billion and no remaining obligation to contribute.
